shale-900.purpose: Ground under photographed stone; scrim base; fields on shale.

shale-800.purpose: Footer rules, disabled checkout, Search hover.

shale-600.purpose: Outlines and underlines on shale. Decorative only.

shale-400.purpose: Muted text on shale; size step bars; sold-out numbers.

mist.purpose: Text, icons and focus on shale, moss and scrimmed photographs.

limestone-300.purpose: Hairlines on limestone; empty box count; counts on shale pills.

limestone-200.purpose: Alternate band (hatch chart, shop story); hover ground.

limestone-100.purpose: Page ground, header, mega menu, drawer.

paper.purpose: Every surface that holds a product photo; fields; box sheet; bin label.

ink.purpose: Text and focus on light grounds; Search button; + Add while in hand.

ink-muted.purpose: Secondary text, units, sizes, hints, counts.

edge.purpose: Control borders and quiet underlines on light grounds.

lichen.purpose: Secondary text and rules on moss; text selection.

halo.purpose: Water and season: in-season hatch months; the field caret.

copper.purpose: Buy actions and figures that count what is in the box, including the shipping meter fill.

copper-deep.purpose: Hover and press for copper fills only.

copper-lit.purpose: The in-box ring and buy figures on shale, including the distance to free shipping. Never a fill or body text.

on-copper.purpose: Labels on copper and deep copper.

light-warm.purpose: The raking light: card-in-hand edge and pool, the current-month column, matched search text.

display.purpose: The one page headline (h1), about 13ch; 32px under 640px.

title.purpose: Plate, pane, species, row-plate, box and drawer names; 19-26px in use.

lead.purpose: The line under the headline; band intros.

label.purpose: Product names, buttons (700), pills, nav and menu links.

caption.purpose: Sizes, hints, units, fine print. Nothing below 13px.

price.purpose: Prices; the unit follows in caption, ink-muted.

count.purpose: Counts on pills, rows and menus; months.

note.purpose: Bin labels, the Now mark, one margin note. At most once per region.

signoff.purpose: Tight lines from us all at ReelFlies.

fonts.fallback: Archivo Condensed Fallback: Arial 80%, Arial Bold 79.1%

fonts.role: the tier's hand, at most once per region

shadows.name: shadow-seat
shadows.purpose: A card resting on stone or moss; the bin label.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Card under the pointer (3px rise); box sheet, drawer, fly in flight.

shadows.name: shadow-rake
shadows.purpose: The card in hand's long shadow and its open size strip.

shadows.name: shadow-light-edge
shadows.purpose: The card in hand's lit upper-left edge; always with shadow-rake; only one card at a time.

shadows.name: shadow-plain
shadows.purpose: Cards on limestone, plates, the active mega-menu rail item.

shadows.name: shadow-drop
shadows.purpose: Mega menu, search suggestions, the shop photograph. Not in the brand chart.

shadows.name: warm-pool
shadows.purpose: Pool of light on stone or moss behind the card in hand (inset -80px -10px 10px -80px).

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Shade, light, lift, underlines, arrows, chevrons.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: Cards arriving as the stone re-lays.

motion.name: drop
motion.purpose: A fly travelling into the order line.

motion.name: drawer-slide
motion.purpose: Phone drawer entering from the left.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All durations collapse; the flying fly is not drawn.

layout.headerDesktop: 76px brand row (scrolls away) + 52px nav row (pinned) from 1040px

focus.dark: 2px solid mist on shale, moss, utility strip and order line; ink on paper cards inside dark bands

photography.product: As shot on white, native 3:2, inside a paper card; never tinted, filtered, covered or badged; bottom-left logo kept clear.
photography.stone: Stand-in slate photographs carry a temporary warm grade (filter: sepia(0.34) saturate(1.3) brightness(0.9) contrast(1.05)) until the commissioned warm-light shoot replaces them. Not a lasting rule.

platform.target: BigCommerce Stencil, Cornerstone 6.22 fork (fresh rebuild; ReelFlies folders plus listed hooks, ADR 0001)

regions.utilityStrip: components/common/utility-strip (theme settings text; phone number from store settings)
regions.header: components/common/header + navigation (category tree, depth 2, server-rendered); mega menu and drawer
regions.stone: pages/home.html region home_stone: Page Builder image; best sellers from front matter products.top_sellers
regions.plates: Fly-type branch of the category tree, server-rendered; plates are category images
regions.species: Species branch of the category tree; laid-out flies from Storefront GraphQL by category
regions.hatchChart: A Web Page's chart placed by a Page Builder widget; matching flies by product id via Storefront GraphQL
regions.orderLine: Theme layer over the Cart API (/api/storefront/carts); the box sheet is the cart preview

narrative.overview:
The shop is a riverside stone in low, warm light, with real flies laid out on it. Wet shale carries the photographed bands and the frame around them, dry limestone is the working ground where reading and choosing happen, and moss is a third field for the species. Every fly sits as photographed on its own white paper card, like a specimen set down by hand. The ground is quiet and warm so the flies carry the colour; the one metal in the system, beadhead copper, appears only where flies go into the box or money changes hands.

Light, not colour, carries state. There is one light, low and warm, from the upper left. A card at rest is seated on the stone; under the pointer it lifts; picked up (its size strip open) it catches the raking light, with a lit edge, a warm pool on the stone and a long shadow thrown down and to the right; once its fly is in the box it keeps a copper-lit ring and says what is in the box on a line that was reserved for it all along. On the hatch chart the current month is a column of the same warm light. Motion is one short settle and one drop; with reduced motion every state is simply there.

The density is that of a working shop, not a gallery: prices, sizes and counts are always visible, in a condensed numeral that reads like a hook-size stamp. Archivo does the work in three cuts; the fly tier's hand, Kalam, appears at most once in a region, as a bin label, a season mark, a margin note or the sign-off.
keyCharacteristics: Three grounds: wet shale (photographed stone, strip, footer, order line), dry limestone (working bands), moss (species). Paper only under products.
One buy colour, beadhead copper, held for buying and for what has been bought.
Archivo in three cuts: Expanded for headings, Archivo for text and controls, Condensed for every number. Kalam as the tier's hand, once per region.
State shown by light: seated at rest, lifted on point, light-edge and rake in hand, copper-lit ring once in the box.
Product photography as shot, on white, never tinted or covered.
Small, honest corners (4px) on cards, buttons, fields and plates; full pills only for ways in, toggles and counts.

rules.name: The Copper Is For Buying Rule
rules.body: Copper marks an action that puts flies in the box or spends money, or a figure that counts what is in the box. Links, headings, navigation, active filters, the Search button, Subscribe and decoration never take it.

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: Shale is photographed stone or the frame around it; limestone is where reading and choosing happen; moss is the species field. A new section picks one of these; paper is never a page ground and no fourth ground is invented.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Text on a stone photograph sits over a scrim of shale (left-to-right on wide screens, top-to-bottom when stacked), lit by a faint warm radial from the upper left, so it holds 4.5:1 on any frame the photographer delivers.

rules.name: The Halo Rule
rules.body: Halo blue means water and time. It never marks a link, a selection or a buy.

rules.name: The Cut Carries the Role Rule
rules.body: Expanded is for headings and names that act as headings. Controls and product names stay in Archivo even inside expanded contexts. Numbers are always Condensed. Hierarchy never comes from a fourth face.

rules.name: The One Hand Per Region Rule
rules.body: Kalam appears at most once in a region, for a bin label, a season mark, a margin note or the sign-off, set slightly askew (−1.5° to −4°). It never carries a price, a button, a size a shopper picks from, a heading or anything needed to buy.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, labels, buttons and group titles are sentence case at normal tracking. Nothing is set in tracked capitals.

rules.name: The Laid, Not Filed Rule
rules.body: From 1040px, specimen cards on stone and on moss are each nudged a few pixels off the grid (up to 5px across, 10px down) so they read as set down by hand. Reading order never changes, and cards on limestone sit on a true grid.

rules.name: The Reserved Line Rule
rules.body: Every specimen card carries one line under its price, holding the size range or, once added, what is in the box. Adding a fly never moves the layout (measured layout shift on add: 0).

rules.name: The Light Marks State Rule
rules.body: At rest a card is seated; pointing lifts it; the card in hand takes the light edge and rake, moves 4px left and 6px up, and casts a warm radial pool on the stone behind its upper left; a fly in the box keeps a 2px copper-lit ring in every one of those states. While the stone re-lays for another way in, cards fade back and the new ones arrive in a short stagger. No other device signals card state.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: The lit edge, the warm pool and the scrim's warm radial always come from the upper left, and shadows fall to the lower right. The hard light edge exists only on the card in hand; only one card is in hand at a time.

rules.name: The Square Buy Rule
rules.body: Buy buttons are 4px rectangles, never pills, so the copper action never reads as a filter.

dos: **Do** show product photos exactly as shot, on white, at their native 3:2, inside a paper specimen card.
**Do** keep the bottom-left corner of every product photo clear: no badge, label or control over the baked-in logo.
**Do** set every price, count, size, hook number and month in Archivo Condensed with tabular figures.
**Do** reserve the in-box line on every card so adding never moves the layout.
**Do** put text on stone photography only over the shale scrim, and leave the stone uncovered where no text is needed.
**Do** treat the warm `.graded` filter on the stand-in slate photographs as temporary: it comes off when the commissioned warm-light shoot replaces them, and it is never applied to product photos.
**Do** give every lit, lifted or dropping state an instant equivalent under reduced motion.
**Do** keep every touch target at least 44px on phones.
donts: **Don't** use copper (or whichever buy colour replaces it) for anything that is not buying or a count of what is being bought.
**Don't** add a fourth type family, set headings in text width, or set controls in Expanded.
**Don't** use Kalam more than once in a region, or for prices, buttons, pickable sizes, headings or anything needed to buy.
**Don't** make buy buttons pills, or give way pills square corners.
**Don't** place type, gradients, filters or controls over a product photo.
**Don't** use the light edge or warm pool on anything but the one card in hand.
**Don't** use paper as a page ground, or put the logo directly on shale, moss or a photograph.
**Don't** set labels or group titles in tracked capitals.
**Don't** nudge cards off the grid anywhere but on stone and moss.
